title: Targum on Exodus
credit: J. W. Etheridge, 1862–1865, public domain. Original desk notes; the update_01 scan has no extractable text.

sections.title: The Name
paragraphs: Exodus 3:14–15 is I AM THAT I AM, and the memorial Name. Onkelos typically renders the Tetragrammaton as “the Lord.” Gematria on this desk counts Yod He Vav He as 26. Keep the count and the Targum on different shelves.

sections.title: The goat for Azazel
paragraphs: Leviticus 16 is the Day of Atonement, not Exodus, but the wilderness sending sits in the same Torah. Azazel is in Strong’s names-of-powers and in 1 Enoch. Exodus itself is the going out, the sea, and Sinai.

sections.title: Beside this chapter
paragraphs: Open the Exodus chapter in the Bible window. This Extra-canon card is a pointer to Etheridge’s public-domain Targum, not a substitute for the Hebrew or the King James.
